title: Tubby Hall, Baby Dodds and drumming technique
summary: Dominique compares Tubby Hall and Baby Dodds, praises their rolls and reading, and criticizes modern drummers' loud bass drum kicking.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
